usage_truncated.$comment: tempdoc 757: TRUE when this cell is a resource-exhausted (wall-clock / usd-budget) API session whose recorded token/cost usage is a partial LOWER BOUND captured up to the kill point, not the complete session accounting. Optional and emitted ONLY when true -- absent (=> None) on every completed cell and on all pre-757 evidence, so historical records project byte-identically. The composer (utility_recompose) may treat a lower bound as exact only when doing so cannot flatter the with-tool arm (baseline-arm truncation is conservative for a B-favouring efficiency claim; any with-tool-arm truncation is anti-conservative and forces the efficiency intervals unavailable, fail-closed).

surface_evidence.$comment: tempdoc 755 Track 1: HOW the observed_mcp_tool_surface_hash was obtained. 'status' = get_mcp_status() reported the surface on the first probe; 'status-retry' = a bounded reprobe recovered it after the transient ~8%/cell flake (675/725); null = no probe reported it (cell unverified -- never a fabricated hash). 'fallback-listing' is reserved for a genuine independent tools-listing seam and is NOT emitted today (no such seam exists; see mcp_surface_fallback). Optional: absent on pre-755 evidence.

mcp_surface_fallback.$comment: tempdoc 755 Track 1 item 2: forensic cross-check recorded when a with-tool cell's status probe stayed empty but the cell executed >=1 mcp__justsearch__* tool. `verified` is always false -- a subset of executed tools cannot establish that the full offered surface equalled the declared surface (integrity rule), so the cell stays unverified. Optional: absent when the fallback path did not run.

mcp_tools_deferred.$comment: Protocol-level end-of-session echo (was the justsearch server connected but its tools reachable only via ToolSearch). Superseded as AUTHORITY by source.exposure_config.exposure_mode (tempdoc 725 increment 2, config-derived, never inferred from the SDK) -- this field stays for its own record, no longer the last word on eager-vs-deferred.

tool_call_sequence.$comment: tempdoc 736 D10 (issue 10): this ordered, per-attempt sequence is the AUTHORITY for per-call outcome (four states: ok/blocked/disallowed/errored). blocked_tool_call_names below is a name-only convenience projection superseded in authority by this field -- kept for the always-emit contract and existing readers, not deleted; a future reader should reconcile against THIS field, not treat the two as two authorities.

furniture_markers.$comment: tempdoc 735 G2: null (not an all-False dict) for a structured-json delivery -- the text-grep tier was never delivered in that case, so there is nothing to grep. Non-null for prose/blocks deliveries (and for all historical pre-735 entries, which are always prose/blocks-shaped dicts).

delivered_tier.$comment: tempdoc 735 G2: which tier the CLI actually delivered to the model for this call, derived from the raw content shape at capture time (agent_utility_inspect._delivered_tier). Absent on pre-735 historical entries -- schema-optional, not required, so old evidence keeps validating.

delivered_fields.$comment: tempdoc 735 G2: top-level structured-evidence field presence, populated only for a structured-json delivery (null otherwise). matchedTerms/excerpts are true if present either at the top level OR nested under any results[] entry (McpEvidenceProjection.java:75-93 puts them per-hit for justsearch_search). Absent on pre-735 historical entries -- schema-optional.

tool_result_digests.$comment: tempdoc 736 D9 (issue 9, committed tier), extended by tempdoc 735 G2 (delivered_tier/delivered_fields): ONE entry per attempt, same order as tool_call_sequence. A redacted derivation of the tool result content -- hash/len/is_error/structural-shape/product-furniture-marker booleans, plus which tier the CLI actually delivered. additionalProperties:false on each entry and NO raw-content property is permitted anywhere in this schema -- the schema structurally forbids committing raw corpus/result text. Raw content lives only in the ephemeral (gitignored) Inspect log.

source.$comment: source_git_state, mcp_tool_surface, corpus_certification, query_identity, and campaign_identity are intentionally NOT required: sanitize_observation() always emits them (as null when unavailable) for freshly captured evidence, but pre-existing evidence captured before these fields existed (e.g. tests/fixtures/agent-utility-rejected-2026-07-12/observations.v1.jsonl) omits the keys entirely. Required-ness is relaxed here to admit that historical evidence rather than to invite new omissions; additionalProperties:false still rejects anything misspelled or unknown, and each key's declared type still applies whenever the key is present.
